steps.name: Clear confirmation skips
steps.do: From the project root, run `npm run clear:itinerary-config`, then reload **Itinerary**.
steps.expect: Command reports no **Don't show this again** skips (or clears any that were on). Short Visit / Early Admission confirmations are no longer skipped.

steps.name: Valid times
steps.do: Set a sensible arrival before departure.

steps.name: Short visit
steps.do: With both arrival and departure set, change them to a visit shorter than **2 hours** (e.g. arrival **10:00 AM**, departure **11:00 AM**).

steps.name: Longer visit
steps.do: Change arrival and departure so the visit is at least **2 hours** (e.g. arrival **10:00 AM**, departure **2:00 PM**).
steps.expect: Times are kept. **Short Visit?** does not appear.

steps.name: Early admission date
steps.do: Via **Edit Itinerary** / **Set Visit Date**, pick a **today-or-future** visit date whose Day Planner shows **Early Admission** before **Zoo Opens** (seed weekends/holidays: Early Admission **9:00 AM**, Zoo Opens **9:30 AM**, through Labor Day). If no such date is selectable, mark **Blocked**.
steps.expect: **Early Admission** appears on the timeline before **Zoo Opens** — or suite **Blocked** if early-admission season has ended.

steps.name: Arrival during early admission
steps.do: If not Blocked: set **Arrival time** to **9:00 AM** (before Zoo Opens). Keep departure at least **2 hours** later so **Short Visit?** does not appear.
steps.expect: **Early Admission Hours** confirmation appears (members/sensory message, with **Don't show this again**).

steps.name: Cancel early admission
steps.do: If not Blocked: click **Cancel** on that confirmation.
steps.expect: Arrival is not saved; the field returns to the previous time (or empty).

steps.name: Confirm early admission
steps.do: If not Blocked: set **Arrival time** to **9:00 AM** again and click **Confirm**.

steps.name: Arrival after open
steps.do: If not Blocked: set **Arrival time** to **10:00 AM** (at or after **Zoo Opens**).
steps.expect: Arrival is kept. **Early Admission Hours** does not appear.

steps.name: Schedule still coherent
steps.do: View Day Planner pills if any.
